parts.bid_monotone: d(b)/d(mu) = t*p > 0 => won-set & conversions non-decreasing in mu; maximised at mu=1
parts.corollary_5_3: mu=1, v_i=t_i: payment = v_i p = welfare contribution => revenue monotonicity implies welfare monotonicity
parts.feasibility: CPA = mu*t; CPA <= t  <=>  mu <= 1  (t>0). mu>1 infeasible.
parts.welfare_argmax: winner = argmax_i t_i p_{i,C} = argmax_i v_i p_{i,C} (Assumption 1) => per-cluster welfare maximal

C3_mu_one_optimality.theorem: Theorem 5.2 + Corollary 5.3: mu=1 optimality and welfare monotonicity

C6_lp_lifting.budget_identity: refined spend reduces to coarse spend under calibration (verified per-i, zero residual)
C6_lp_lifting.calibration: sum_j w_{C^A_j} p^A_{i,j} = w_C p^B_i (mean-preserving refinement); p^B_i solved & substituted
C6_lp_lifting.objective_identity: refined lifted objective == coarse objective (zero residual) => refined optimum >= coarse
C6_lp_lifting.supply: x^A_{i,C^A_j} := x^B_{i,C} (verbatim copy) => sum_i x^A = sum_i x^B <= 1
C6_lp_lifting.theorem: Theorem 5.11: LP benchmark monotonicity via lifting
